preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(char.islower() or char.isdigit() for char in input)
preconditions.description: The string must contain only lowercase letters and digits.

postconditions.description: The output must be an integer.

postconditions.expression: output == max(int(num) for num in re.findall(r'\d+', input))
postconditions.description: The output must be the largest number found in the string.
